title: UPSHIFT
blurb: 650 m first-person course over 14 rooftops in six sectors, with checkpoints.

verification.notes: Spawns standing on the start roof at the START HERE marking; idle 500/2000/5000 identical. Sprint carries the player ~20 m forward to the first red vault block, where it stops (speed 0) as designed: vaulting needs E. No page errors, no mis-encoded text.
